heading: cyProof of rent arrears
paragraphs: cyAs your claim is on the grounds of rent arrears, you must now answer questions about:
bullets: cyhow much the arrears were on the date you served notice, if you served notice
cyhow much the rent arrears are on today’s date
cyhow much the rent is and how frequently it should be paid

contentBlocks.text: cyYou must also provide proof of how the rent arrears have built up over time. You can either:

bullets: cyupload a rent statement that follows specific guidelines

contentBlocks.text: cyThe defendant will be able to see your answers and any documents you upload.
